scope: The surviving granite Klipkerk on Pieter Malan Street, including its square bell tower, perpendicular gables, rose windows and low side turret.

references.artist: Original uploader was Morné van Rooyen at af.wikipedia

originalReview.notes: The exact 2008 photograph documents two gray masonry gables, pale standing-seam roofs, carved circular windows, tall square clock tower and arched belfry openings under a low hipped top.

quallaSearch.notes: Started from the exact published Qualla file. Photographer Morné van Rooyen identified the original as his own work and released it to the public domain. The archived first transfer retains the source statement and upload identity.
